content_of_post_to_comment: Let Go Of The Specifics In Order To Meet Your Goal ✨ Its a humbling experience realizing things always won’t go EXACTLY the way you have envisioned. But it doesn’t have to be with that specific person, or at that specific job. Or done in that particular way in order to meet your goal.
comment: I’ve found that letting go of the exact path doesn’t mean lowering your standards, it just leaves room for better opportunities you couldn’t have predicted. Sometimes we get attached to a specific person or outcome because we can’t see alternatives yet. The tricky part is staying open without becoming passive about what you want.
